story_zh: 在毕业典礼上，我代表全体学生发言。首先，我表达了对老师的尊敬和对同学的珍惜。我表明，大学四年是宝贵的经历，包含了许多美好回忆。虽然面临未来挑战，但我们会保持积极态度，尽力实现梦想。最后，我感谢学校的培养，并祝愿大家前途光明。
story_pinyin: Zài bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng, wǒ dàibiǎo quántǐ xuéshēng fāyán. Shǒuxiān, wǒ biǎodá le duì lǎoshī de zūnjìng hé duì tóngxué de zhēnxī. Wǒ biǎomíng, dàxué sì nián shì bǎoguì de jīnglì, bāohán le xǔduō měihǎo huíyì. Suīrán miànlín wèilái tiǎozhàn, dàn wǒmen huì bǎochí jījí tàidù, jìnlì shíxiàn mèngxiǎng. Zuìhòu, wǒ gǎnxiè xuéxiào de péiyǎng, bìng zhùyuàn dàjiā qiántú guāngmíng.
story_en: At the graduation ceremony, I represented all students in giving a speech. First, I expressed respect for our teachers and cherished our classmates. I indicated that the four years of university were valuable experiences, containing many beautiful memories. Although we face future challenges, we will maintain a positive attitude and try our best to realize our dreams. Finally, I thanked the school for its cultivation and wished everyone a bright future.
